units.source_text: 古歌：“更科舍姨山，月色太凄清。

en.t: An old poem says: At Obasute Mountain in Sarashina, the moonlight is far too cold and lonely.

units.source_text: 望月增忧思，不能慰我情。”

en.t: Gazing at the full moon only deepens my sorrow; it cannot comfort my heart.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 舍姨山在信浓国更科郡。

en.t: Obasute Mountain is in Sarashina District of Shinano Province.

units.source_text: 此处引用此歌，意思是不能慰二女公子之情。

en.t: The poem is quoted here to mean that the feelings of the two young ladies cannot be comforted.
